formulas.description: Gitlab #30528 when opportunity Active Pipeline Indicator (FORMULA) equals Last Year,Future,More than 1 year old or Stage equals Dead,Postponed,Lost then update Active Pipeline equals to False.
formulas.name: ActivePipelineIndicatorFORMULA
formulas.expression:
CASE((VALUE(MID(TEXT({!$Record.CloseDate}),1,4)) - VALUE(MID(TEXT(TODAY()),1,4))),
-1, "Last Year", 0, "Current Year", 1, "Next Year", 2, "Future", 3, "Future", 4, "Future", 5, "Future", "More than 1 year old")
